about: SYSTEM S6. Every state x disruption. contract: PRESERVE | RETIRE | NOT_APPLICABLE | UNDECIDED. status: EXERCISED_EXISTING/NEW/BOTH (a named, source-present test runs the cell) | DERIVED (follows from a cited exercised cell by shared code path; NOT counted as exercised) | NOT_APPLICABLE | GAP (meaningful, untested) | DECISION (contract undecided). Only EXERCISED_* count as covered. Coverage statuses map named host tests, NOT execution. build/tools/matrix_status.py combines them with hash-checked GREEN receipts; real process kill, ART IME and GPU are separate phone claims.
